description: Contract version 0.1.0. First machine-readable evaluation-case contract per SPEC-022 (ADR-011, ADR-014): assertions are the sole scoring contract; partition and suite membership live in the versioned case-set manifest, outside the case record; company and dates are stage-specific typed context.

stage_context.description: Stage-specific typed context (for example company, observation date, secondary dates, or frontier-model context). No child field is universally required, and the object may be empty. Structural validation beyond 'object' is delegated to the applicable stage-specific contract identified by `stage` until stage-specific context schemas are introduced.

semantic_version.description: Assertion semantic version. At least one of `semantic_version` or `contract_hash` is required.

contract_hash.description: Assertion contract hash. At least one of `semantic_version` or `contract_hash` is required.

scoring_gate_config_references.description: References to the applicable protected-class and severity definitions in the versioned scoring/gate configuration. Values are never hardcoded in case records.

items.description: Common assertion contract only (SPEC-022). Kind-specific expected payload shapes, assertion outcomes, matcher and scoring policy, and protected-class, severity, gate, or failure-taxonomy enumerations are governed by later approved contracts and versioned configuration, not by this schema.
